reproduction_target: Computational analysis of multi-assay chromatin-structure sequencing data in K562 CRISPRi pan-H1-depleted cells and other cell types: (i) RICC-seq 2.0 read alignment, region subsetting, fragment-length-distribution (FLD) generation, spike-in normalization and length-bias correction with per-bp Welch t-testing; (ii) Hi-C / Micro-C alignment (Dovetail pipeline: bwa mem + pairtools), cooler/juicer matrix generation, P(s) curves (cooltools), HiCRep SCC replicate correlation, CscoreTool compartment analysis against ENCODE H3K36me3, cooltools insulation domain calling, juicer HiCCUPS loop calling / motif annotation / APA, and custom short-range contact-probability + NRL analysis; (iii) RNA-seq UMI processing (fastp), STAR alignment to GRCh38+ERCC, featureCounts, DESeq2 with ERCC spike-in size factors; (iv) ATAC-seq alignment, Tn5 shift correction, MACS2 + IDR peak calling, DESeq2 differential accessibility, chromHMM-stratified FLD; (v) CUT&Tag H3K27me3 alignment, SICER2 peak calling, deepTools bigwig/heatmap generation, DESeq2 differential peaks, ChIPseeker annotation; (vi) two unnamed-URL Risca Lab Nextflow pipelines (NEXDEP + a peak-calling/downstream pipeline) that wrap many of the above; (vii) SWATH-MS proteomics search/quantification (ProteinPilot, PeakView).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool-invocation derived from the bioRxiv JATS Methods prose (fetched 2026-07-28 via curl; WebFetch returned HTTP 403). No workflow file was read — the paper names two Nextflow pipelines but publishes no repository URL, so no objective workflow source exists at Stage 1. 29 computational steps (layer C) verdicted; 10 coarse wet-lab blocks (cell culture/CRISPRi induction, RICC-seq 2.0 library prep incl. irradiation, Hi-C library prep, in-situ Micro-C incl. crosslinking + MNase titration, ATAC-seq library prep, CUT&Tag library prep, RNA extraction + RNA-seq library prep, ChEP chromatin enrichment, LC-MS/MS acquisition, HPLC H1:nucleosome quantification) counted in W and excluded from |S| as OOS. Decisive finding: this preprint contains NO Data Availability section and NO Code Availability section anywhere in the JATS XML or on the bioRxiv landing page — no accession is stated for any of the six author-generated sequencing/proteomics datasets, and no repository is stated for the analysis code. Data axis is therefore 0 on every computational step, so every step caps at NI regardless of its otherwise-good version and parameter documentation. Version axis was scored strictly per-subsection: version=1 only where a version is stated for that tool in the subsection describing that invocation (e.g. DESeq2 v1.42.0 is pinned in the RNA-seq subsection but restated nowhere in the ATAC-seq or CUT&Tag subsections, so those invocations score version=0).

steps.label: RICC-seq 2.0 read alignment: Bowtie2 to prebuilt Bowtie2Index references (hg38/hg19/mm10 + yeast spike-in), MAPQ >= 30, optional blacklist removal — no Bowtie2 version
RICC-seq region subsetting: samtools sort -n then bedtools pairtobed -type ospan over BAM x BED combinations — no versions
Fragment-length histogram: Picard Toolkit CollectInsertSizeMetrics (DEVIATIONS=10.0, MINIMUM_PCT=0.05, HISTOGRAM_WIDTH=700, duplicates excluded) — no Picard version

FLD spike-in normalization + fragment-length-bias correction + 180 bp mononucleosome normalization + 10 bp rolling smoothing + per-bp Welch t-tests (>= 5 bp contiguous) — custom code, not deposited; TapeStation ladder input not provided
Hi-C / Micro-C alignment and QC filtering per Dovetail Genomics pipeline (micro-c.readthedocs.io): bwa mem v0.7.17 two-sided, pairtools parse v0.3.0, pairtools split dedup
Contact-matrix generation: cooler cload + zoomify v0.8.6 (ICE-balanced mcool, 500 bp base resolution, default params) and juicer_tools pre v1.22.01 (hic, 500 bp base resolution, default params)
P(s) contact-decay curves: cooltools v0.5.4 expected_cis at 10 kb resolution with smoothing (smoothing parameters unspecified)
Replicate correlation: HiCRep stratum-adjusted correlation (SCC) on 500 kb full contact matrices converted with juicer/straw v1.6 — HiCRep version and h/maxdist parameters absent

Compartment analysis: CscoreTool v1.1 per chromosome on 100 kb pairs, sign-flipped by Spearman correlation with ENCODE H3K36me3 ChIP (ENCSR000AKR), p<0.01 chromosome exclusion, |delta c-score|>0.25 shift threshold
Domain/insulation calling: cooltools insulation on balanced mcool at 10 kb resolution — no version restated in this subsection, insulation window sizes unspecified

Loop calling and annotation: juicer HiCCUPS at 5 kb with KR normalization on inward-ligation-filtered hic, juicer motifs with ENCODE K562 SMC3 (ENCSR000EGW) / RAD21 (ENCSR000FAD) / CTCF (ENCSR000EGM) ChIP-seq, juicer APA — no version restated, HiCCUPS/APA parameters otherwise unspecified

Short-range contact probability and NRL: custom ligation-orientation splitting of pairs (+/-, -/+, +/+ , -/-), bedtools intersect v2.30.0 for region restriction, second-derivative peak detection, N/N+odd:N/N+even ratio computation — custom code not deposited
RNA-seq UMI extraction and unique-read filtering: fastp v0.24.0 (--umi_loc per_read --umi_skip 2 --umi_len 5)

RNA-seq alignment: STAR v2.7.11b to combined GRCh38 + ERCC transcriptome index (full parameter list given: --outFilterType BySJout --outFilterMultimapNmax 15 --alignSJoverhangMin 8 --alignSJDBoverhangMin 1 --outFilterMismatchNmax 500 --outFilterMismatchNoverReadLmax 0.05 --alignIntronMin 20 --alignIntronMax 1000000)
RNA-seq counting: featureCounts (subread v2.0.6) paired-end fragment counts over combined gencode.v38 + ERCC annotation — strandedness and other flags unspecified
RNA-seq differential expression: DESeq2 v1.42.0 on genes with >= 10 total counts, ERCC genes as control set via estimateSizeFactors
ATAC-seq alignment and Tn5 shift correction: Bowtie2 alignment, unspecified filtering, deepTools alignmentSieve (+4/-5 shift) — no versions in this subsection
ATAC-seq peak calling: MACS2 followed by IDR reproducible-peak selection and master-peak-set construction by concatenating adjacent peaks — no versions, no MACS2 or IDR thresholds stated

ATAC-seq differential accessibility: GenomicRanges (R) master-peak load and DESeq2 run separately on peaks within 5 kb of a TSS vs distal peaks — no versions in this subsection, no significance thresholds stated

ATAC-seq fragment-length distributions over K562 chromHMM regions: samtools replicate merge, bedtools bamtobed -bedpe, awk extraction of true fragment spans, bedtools intersect with chromHMM regions — no versions, chromHMM track source/version unstated
CUT&Tag alignment: BWA mem, unspecified filtering, duplicate removal — no versions, no filter criteria
CUT&Tag peak calling: SICER2 per replicate then concatenation into a master peak set — no version, no SICER2 window/gap/FDR parameters
CUT&Tag coverage tracks: deepTools bamCoverage with reads extended and CPM normalization — no version, bin size unspecified
CUT&Tag differential peaks and PCA: DESeq2 over master peak set (padj < 0.05 and |log2 fold change| > 2) plus DESeq2-based PCA — no version in this subsection
Differential-peak genomic annotation with ChIPseeker — no version, no TSS region / annotation database version stated

deepTools heatmaps and profile plots of bigwig signal over differential peak centers (+/- 5 kb), over PRO-seq nascent transcription regions, and over differential ATAC peaks — no version, no computeMatrix/plotHeatmap parameters

Risca Lab Nextflow pipelines: NEXDEP (ATAC-seq / CUT&Tag / CUT&RUN / ChIP-seq align-filter-QC-to-BAM) and a second peak-calling + downstream-analysis pipeline with 'many other custom analytical Nextflow workflow techniques' — no repository URL, no pipeline version, no Nextflow version, no config or profile

Proteomics IDA spectral-library search: ProteinPilot version 5.0.2 (ABSciex), default tryptic digest + IAA alkylation settings — proprietary closed software; the searched protein sequence database is not identified by name or version

SWATH/DIA quantification: PeakView version 2.2.0.11391 with SWATH Acquisition MicroApp version 2.0.1.2133 (ABSciex) — 25 peptides/protein, 6 transitions/peptide, 95% peptide confidence, 5% peptide FDR, 10 min XIC window, 100 ppm XIC width, PLEC/MYH9 retention-time calibration — proprietary closed software

headline.static_readiness: 0/29 (0%) — stage1 ceiling only, no R★ (R★ requires stage-2 code verification). Qualifier (mandatory): unexecuted; declared environment statically valid but not verified as the env that produced the results. Co-reported: n_exact_capture_unexecuted = 0, n_fetch_required = 0. has_validated_env_capture = false, so this per-paper ratio is descriptive only and under-claims by construction — Tier-1 cannot credit an undeclared-but-present dependency.
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 0/29 (0%) readiness upper bound (n(R★)+n(RI))/|S|. Every one of the 29 computational steps caps at NI because the Data axis is 0 everywhere: the preprint carries no Data Availability statement and no accession for any author-generated dataset (RICC-seq 2.0, Hi-C, Micro-C, ATAC-seq, CUT&Tag H3K27me3, RNA-seq, SWATH-MS). This is the single dominant blocker — 12 of 29 steps already carry exact prose version pins (bwa 0.7.17, pairtools 0.3.0, cooler 0.8.6, juicer_tools 1.22.01, cooltools 0.5.4, CscoreTool 1.1, bedtools 2.30.0, fastp 0.24.0, STAR 2.7.11b, subread 2.0.6, DESeq2 1.42.0, ProteinPilot 5.0.2 / PeakView 2.2.0.11391) and 9 steps carry complete parameter sets, so depositing the raw data alone would move roughly 12 steps from NI to RI. If the data were deposited, the remaining ceiling would still be RI, not R★: there is no lockfile, container, or conda environment claimed anywhere.
headline.coverage: 29 computational steps assessed from the bioRxiv v1 JATS Methods prose (fetched by curl 2026-07-28; WebFetch 403). 10 coarse wet-lab blocks counted in W and excluded as OOS. Computational coverage |S|/(|S|+|W|) = 29/39 = 74%.
